methods.label: Add the coefficients
methods.explanation: When combining like terms, add the coefficients and keep the variable part unchanged: \(3+5-2=6\), so the result is \(6a\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 7 combining-like-terms rule and elementary arithmetic.
